description: This file contains shell functions related to system initialization and setup, specifically for handling boot hooks, mounting filesystems, and pivoting root filesystems during system startup in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Sets a flag to indicate the start of a splice operation in boot hooks.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Completes splice operations for registered hooks, restoring previous state.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a boot hook list for a given hook name.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified boot hook list, handling splice state.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and retrieves the first function from a boot hook list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions registered under a specific boot hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation, moving system filesystems to a new root.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots to it as root.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates a ram-based overlay filesystem and pivots to it.
